response.answerText:
Krux.news is Rakshit Lodha’s AI-driven news product for people who want to understand AI company updates quickly without reading long articles.

The documented product direction is a short, mobile-first, swipeable feed. It started as an idea around comparing LLM-written articles, then pivoted into concise, persona-aware AI news stories. The intended audience includes product managers, VCs, and AI enthusiasts who want fast updates.

From the evidence available, Rakshit built it with a Python backend for RSS ingestion, AI curation, and content generation, plus a Next.js frontend for the user experience. It also includes distribution and engagement features like RSS/sitemap support and swipe reactions.
